metadata.page_date_guardrail: The project page exposes no publication day. It says construction began in 2025 and gives a future 2027 delivery schedule; the lifecycle date is the 2026-07-19 current-page capture date, not an invented day within 2025.

metadata.project_scope: PAR15 is retained as the named first planned facility without a project-level lifecycle observation. PAR16 and PAR17 are not modeled as separate projects.
metadata.capacity_scope: The page reports 176 MW of IT capacity for the full three-data-center campus. The value is imported only as planned campus critical-IT capacity and is not assigned to PAR15 or the current physical phase.
metadata.space_guardrail: More than 65,000 square meters is planned full-campus IT space, not a power, energy, PUE, or building-footprint observation.
metadata.forecast_guardrail: PAR15 delivery in 2027 is a plan, not evidence of completion, commissioning, or operation.
metadata.classification_guardrail: Intended support for sovereign cloud and AI infrastructure does not establish an actual workload, tenant, customer, user, or operating-model observation.
